title: Demand on a fictional 24-slot worker pool
method: Synthetic demand snapshot totals 36 jobs against 24 slots. A proposed hard cap of 8 per tenant bounds this example to 24 admitted jobs when all three are active; equal concurrency is not equal compute cost or a universal fairness policy.
alt: Demand on a fictional 24-slot worker pool. Tenant A: 20 requested concurrent jobs; Tenant B: 8 requested concurrent jobs; Tenant C: 8 requested concurrent jobs. Illustrative inputs.
